semantic.justification: Original DirectoryItem_Impl and directory-item C/wrapper lifetime, get/status and inode-only identity are ported over genuine selected libc access/lstat/realpath. FileStatus preserves zero construction, source masks, cheap grouped fields, default/retained values, late partial errors and independently owned string/time getters. FileBase retains source RC aliases, URL wrappers and DirectoryItem inheritance. Shared path helper basename/dot/hidden mutation and OString length/pointer/reverse-byte equality use original RTL owners/templates. Native byte-path decoding and full64-bit size/inode fields are not replaced by host filesystem APIs or fake stat providers. The actual selected SDK dirent feature and header-derived sizeof72 are compiler-generated, with original XML enum values retained. Original UNIX QA root-dependent attribute expectations remain unmodified and two fail against real SDK geteuid0/access behavior; kernel semantics are preserved and documented. SvFileStream/TempFile/copy/remove, directory enumeration/remaining FileBase APIs, native ABI/OOM/debug/race/invalid lifetime, full upstream fixtures and complete package/storage/model/filter/UI remain unfinished or unqualified.
